test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The ratio of the speeds of two trucks is 7 : 4. The time taken by the faster truck to cover a distance of 196 km is 7 hours less than the other. Find the speed of the slower truck.
solution:
**Given:**

Speed ratio of two trucks = 7 : 4

Distance covered = 196 km

Time difference = 7 hours

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculation:**

Let the speed of the faster truck = 7x and the speed of the slower truck = 4x.

Time taken by the faster truck = 196 ÷ 7x

Time taken by the slower truck = 196 ÷ 4x

Time difference = Time taken by the slower truck - Time taken by the faster truck

⇒ 196 ÷ 4x − 196 ÷ 7x = 7

⇒ 196(1 ÷ 4x − 1 ÷ 7x) = 7

⇒ 196((7 − 4) ÷ 28x) = 7

⇒ 196(3 ÷ 28x) = 7

⇒ 588 ÷ 28x = 7

⇒ 21 ÷ x = 7

⇒ x = 3

Speed of the slower truck = 4x = 4 × 3 = 12 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 12 km/hr.**
